627ba5077d0ff2a61456f03085034d7d9d9488ef: La Pierre-Saint-Martin is a small, low-key resort: 27 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and lift queues that barely exist. The family reputation of La Pierre-Saint-Martin is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for learning to ski with children. La Pierre-Saint-Martin's altitude (1,650 m at the base, 2,115 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover through midwinter. January and February are the most reliable; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The day lift pass at €43 places La Pierre-Saint-Martin among the mid-range resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short, La Pierre-Saint-Martin doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.
